# Load Libraries and Data
```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(readxl)
library(tools)

# Load TCGA data and pretrained models
load("SKCM.rda")      # contains query2
load("lasso.RData")   # contains lasso_mod
load("rf.RData")      # contains rf_model, rf_median_score

# Prepare clinical data frame
clinical <- colData(query2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(
    bcr_patient_barcode,
    gender,
    vital_status,
    days_to_death,
    ajcc_pathologic_stage,
    age_at_diagnosis
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event         = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & !is.na(event))

# Prepare expression data
log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)
matched <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical_matched <- clinical[matched, ]
expr_survival <- t(log_expr[, matched])

# AJCC stage levels for dropdown
stage_levels <- sort(unique(clinical_matched$ajcc_pathologic_stage))

# Get feature names from models
# For LASSO Cox model
lasso_features <- rownames(coef(lasso_mod))
lasso_features <- lasso_features[lasso_features != "(Intercept)"]

# For Random Forest model
rf_features <- names(rf_model$forest$xlevels)

# Select top genes by variance for manual input
# We'll use the top 10 genes from each model for better prediction
top_lasso_genes <- head(lasso_features, 10)
top_rf_genes <- head(setdiff(rf_features, c("survival_time", "event")), 10)
top_genes <- unique(c(top_lasso_genes, top_rf_genes))

# Create sanitized input IDs for each gene
input_id_map <- setNames(
  paste0("expr_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", top_genes)),
  top_genes
)
```

# Server
```{r}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Clinical data summary
  output$data_summary <- renderPrint({
    cat("TCGA SKCM Cohort Summary:\n\n")
    cat("Number of patients:", nrow(clinical_matched), "\n")
    cat("Gender distribution:\n")
    print(table(clinical_matched$gender))
    cat("\nStage distribution:\n")
    print(table(clinical_matched$ajcc_pathologic_stage))
    cat("\nVital status:\n")
    print(table(clinical_matched$vital_status))
    cat("\nAge statistics:\n")
    print(summary(clinical_matched$age_diagnosis))
    cat("\nSurvival time statistics (years):\n")
    print(summary(clinical_matched$survival_time))
  })

  # Render tables
  output$tbl_clinical <- renderDT({
    datatable(clinical_matched, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  
  output$tbl_expr <- renderDT({
    expr_sample <- as.data.frame(expr_survival[1:20, 1:10])
    datatable(expr_sample, options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  
  # KM plot
  output$survival_plot <- renderPlot({
    clinical_matched$stage_group <- factor(
      ifelse(grepl("III|IV", clinical_matched$ajcc_pathologic_stage), "Advanced", "Early"),
      levels = c("Early", "Advanced")
    )
    
    # Create KM plot
    surv_obj <- Surv(clinical_matched$survival_time, clinical_matched$event)
    fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ stage_group, data = clinical_matched)
    
    plot1 <- ggsurvplot(
      fit, 
      data = clinical_matched,
      pval = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      risk.table = TRUE,
      xlab = "Years",
      palette = c("#2E9FDF", "#E7B800"),
      title = "Survival by Stage Group",
      legend.title = "Stage Group",
      risk.table.height = 0.25
    )
    
    # Gender KM plot
    fit2 <- survfit(surv_obj ~ gender, data = clinical_matched)
    plot2 <- ggsurvplot(
      fit2, 
      data = clinical_matched,
      pval = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      risk.table = FALSE,
      xlab = "Years",
      palette = c("#FF9999", "#6699CC"),
      title = "Survival by Gender"
    )
    
    # Arrange plots
    grid.arrange(
      plot1$plot, plot2$plot, plot1$table,
      layout_matrix = rbind(c(1,2), c(3,3)),
      heights = c(3, 1)
    )
  })
  
  # Template download
  output$download_template <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      "melanoma_risk_template.csv"
    },
    content = function(file) {
      # Create template with clinical variables and top genes
      template_df <- data.frame(
        age_diagnosis = 60,
        gender = "male",
        ajcc_pathologic_stage = "Stage III"
      )
      
      # Add gene columns with example values
      for (gene in top_genes) {
        template_df[[gene]] = 5
      }
      
      write.csv(template_df, file, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  )
  
  # Setup gene expression presets
  observeEvent(input$set_high_risk, {
    # Set expression values to mimic high-risk pattern
    # This is a simplified example - in reality would use actual patterns from clustering
    high_risk_values <- sapply(top_genes, function(gene) {
      if (gene %in% top_lasso_genes[1:5]) {
        return(runif(1, 8, 12))  # Upregulated genes
      } else {
        return(runif(1, 0, 3))   # Downregulated genes
      }
    })
    
    for (gene in names(high_risk_values)) {
      updateNumericInput(session, input_id_map[[gene]], value = high_risk_values[gene])
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$set_low_risk, {
    # Set expression values to mimic low-risk pattern
    low_risk_values <- sapply(top_genes, function(gene) {
      if (gene %in% top_lasso_genes[1:5]) {
        return(runif(1, 0, 3))   # Downregulated high-risk genes
      } else {
        return(runif(1, 8, 12))  # Upregulated protective genes
      }
    })
    
    for (gene in names(low_risk_values)) {
      updateNumericInput(session, input_id_map[[gene]], value = low_risk_values[gene])
    }
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$set_median, {
    # Set all genes to their median values from the dataset
    median_values <- sapply(top_genes, function(gene) {
      if (gene %in% colnames(expr_survival)) {
        return(round(median(expr_survival[, gene], na.rm = TRUE), 2))
      } else {
        return(5)
      }
    })
    
    for (gene in names(median_values)) {
      updateNumericInput(session, input_id_map[[gene]], value = median_values[gene])
    }
  })

  # Function to prepare a complete feature matrix with all needed genes
  prepare_feature_matrix <- function(df, feature_list) {
    # Start with the clinical variables we have
    result_df <- data.frame(
      age_diagnosis = df$age_diagnosis,
      gender = factor(df$gender, levels = levels(clinical_matched$gender)),
      ajcc_pathologic_stage = factor(df$ajcc_pathologic_stage, levels = stage_levels)
    )
    
    # Add all genes from feature_list with default values of 0 if missing
    for (feature in feature_list) {
      if (feature %in% names(df)) {
        result_df[[feature]] <- df[[feature]]
      } else {
        # Use median value from training data as default
        if (feature %in% colnames(expr_survival)) {
          result_df[[feature]] <- median(expr_survival[, feature], na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          result_df[[feature]] <- 0
        }
      }
    }
    
    return(result_df)
  }

  # Function to load data from various file formats
  load_patient_data <- function(file_path) {
    file_ext <- tools::file_ext(file_path)
    
    tryCatch({
      if (file_ext == "csv") {
        df <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      } else if (file_ext %in% c("xls", "xlsx")) {
        df <- readxl::read_excel(file_path) %>% as.data.frame()
      } else if (file_ext == "RData") {
        env <- new.env()
        load(file_path, envir = env)
        # Look for the first data frame in the loaded environment
        obj_names <- ls(envir = env)
        df_names <- obj_names[sapply(obj_names, function(x) is.data.frame(env[[x]]))]
        if (length(df_names) > 0) {
          df <- env[[df_names[1]]]
        } else {
          stop("No data frame found in RData file")
        }
      } else if (file_ext == "rds") {
        df <- readRDS(file_path)
        if (!is.data.frame(df)) {
          stop("RDS file does not contain a data frame")
        }
      } else {
        stop("Unsupported file format")
      }
      
      return(df)
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error loading file:", e$message), type = "error")
      return(NULL)
    })
  }

  # Reactive patient data
  patient_data <- eventReactive(input$goBtn, {
    if (input$input_type == "manual") {
      # Create base data frame with clinical variables
      df <- data.frame(
        age_diagnosis = input$age,
        gender = input$gender,
        ajcc_pathologic_stage = input$stage,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # Add gene expression values
      for (gene in top_genes) {
        df[[gene]] <- input[[input_id_map[[gene]]]]
      }
      
      return(df)
    } else {
      # For file upload
      req(input$file)
      df <- load_patient_data(input$file$datapath)
      
      if (is.null(df)) {
        showNotification("Failed to load patient data file", type = "error")
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      # Verify required columns
      required_cols <- c("age_diagnosis", "gender", "ajcc_pathologic_stage")
      missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
      
      if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
        showNotification(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse=", ")), type = "error")
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      return(df)
    }
  })

  # Manage tab selection based on model choice
  observe({
    if (input$goBtn > 0) {
      if (input$model_choice == "lasso") {
        updateTabsetPanel(session, "result_tabs", selected = "lasso_tab")
      } else if (input$model_choice == "rf") {
        updateTabsetPanel(session, "result_tabs", selected = "rf_tab")
      } else if (input$model_choice == "both") {
        updateTabsetPanel(session, "result_tabs", selected = "comp_tab")
      }
    }
  })

  # Make predictions when button is clicked
  observeEvent(input$goBtn, {
    req(patient_data())
    df <- patient_data()
    
    # Random Forest predictions
    if (input$model_choice %in% c("rf", "both")) {
      # Prepare features needed for RF model
      rf_needed_features <- setdiff(rf_features, c("survival_time", "event"))
      rf_df <- prepare_feature_matrix(df, rf_needed_features)
      
      # Predict using RF model
      pred_time <- predict(rf_model, newdata = rf_df)
      rf_risk_group <- ifelse(pred_time < rf_median_score, "High", "Low")
      
      # Calculate training set performance metrics for reference
      # NOTE: We're using a binary indicator for 3-year survival to create the ROC curve
      train_survival_binary <- ifelse(clinical_matched$survival_time <= 3 & clinical_matched$event == 1, 1, 0)
      train_preds <- predict(rf_model, newdata = expr_survival)
      
      # Calculate true positive and true negative rates for different thresholds
      # This works because lower predicted survival time = higher risk
      pred_for_roc <- -train_preds  # Invert so higher values = higher risk
      
      # Display results
      output$rf_score <- renderPrint({
        cat("Predicted Survival Time:", round(pred_time, 2), "years\n")
        cat("Risk Group:", rf_risk_group, "\n")
        cat("Median Survival Time in Training Set:", round(rf_median_score, 2), "years\n")
      })
      
      # Variable importance plot
      output$rf_varimp <- renderPlot({
        varImpPlot(rf_model, n.var = 15, main = "Top 15 Variable Importance")
      })
      
      # Error plot
      output$rf_error_plot <- renderPlot({
        # Create density plot for predicted vs actual survival times
        actual <- clinical_matched$survival_time
        predicted <- predict(rf_model, newdata = expr_survival)
        
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          Time = c(actual, predicted),
          Type = c(rep("Actual", length(actual)), rep("Predicted", length(predicted)))
        )
        
        ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Time, fill = Type)) +
          geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
          theme_minimal() +
          labs(
            title = "Distribution of Survival Times",
            x = "Survival Time (Years)",
            y = "Density"
          ) +
          scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
      })
      
      # Top important genes
      output$rf_important_genes <- renderPrint({
        imp <- importance(rf_model)
        top_imp <- sort(imp[, "%IncMSE"], decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
        cat("Top 10 important features (Random Forest):\n")
        for (i in 1:10) {
          feature <- names(top_imp)[i]
          score <- top_imp[i]
          cat(i, ". ", feature, " (Importance: ", round(score, 3), ")\n", sep = "")
        }
      })
      
      # Clinical interpretation
      output$rf_interpretation <- renderUI({
        median_survival <- round(rf_median_score, 1)
        pred_survival <- round(pred_time, 1)
        
        HTML(paste0(
          "<p>The Random Forest model predicts a survival time of <strong>", pred_survival, " years</strong> for this patient. ",
          "This prediction is based on the patient's clinical characteristics and gene expression profile.</p>",
          
          "<p>The median predicted survival in the training cohort is ", median_survival, " years. ",
          "This patient's prediction is ", ifelse(pred_time < median_survival, "<strong>below", "<strong>above"), " the median</strong>, ",
          "placing them in the ", ifelse(pred_time < median_survival, "<span style='color:red'>higher</span>", "<span style='color:green'>lower</span>"), " risk group.</p>",
          
          "<p>The most informative features for this prediction include age, disease stage, and expression levels of key genes ",
          "such as those involved in immune response, cell cycle regulation, and melanoma-specific pathways.</p>"
        ))
      })
    }

    # LASSO Cox predictions
    if (input$model_choice %in% c("lasso", "both")) {
      # Prepare features needed for LASSO model
      lasso_df <- prepare_feature_matrix(df, lasso_features)
      
      # Convert to matrix for glmnet
      x_new <- as.matrix(lasso_df[, lasso_features, drop = FALSE])
      
      # Predict risk score
      lp <- predict(lasso_mod, newx = x_new, type = "link")
      
      # Get distribution of scores from training set for context
      train_x <- as.matrix(expr_survival[, lasso_features, drop = FALSE])
      train_scores <- predict(lasso_mod, newx = train_x, type = "link")
      score_quantile <- ecdf(train_scores)(lp)
      risk_group <- ifelse(lp > median(train_scores), "High", "Low")
      
      # Display results
      output$lasso_score <- renderPrint({
        cat("LASSO Cox Risk Score:", round(lp, 3), "\n")
        cat("Risk Percentile:", round(score_quantile * 100), "%\n")
        cat("Risk Group:", risk_group, "\n")
      })
      
      # Coefficient plot
      output$lasso_coefs <- renderPlot({
        coefs <- as.numeric(coef(lasso_mod))
        names(coefs) <- rownames(coef(lasso_mod))
        coefs <- coefs[coefs != 0]
        
        # Exclude intercept and order by absolute magnitude
        coefs <- coefs[names(coefs) != "(Intercept)"]
        coef_order <- order(abs(coefs), decreasing = TRUE)
        top_coefs <- coefs[coef_order][1:min(20, length(coefs))]
        
        # Prepare data frame for plotting
        coef_df <- data.frame(
          Feature = factor(names(top_coefs), levels = names(top_coefs)[order(top_coefs)]),
          Coefficient = top_coefs
        )
        
        # Create the plot
        ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = Feature, y = Coefficient, fill = Coefficient > 0)) +
          geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
          coord_flip() +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "blue"), 
                            labels = c("Higher Risk", "Lower Risk"),
                            name = "Effect") +
          labs(
            title = "Top LASSO Model Coefficients",
            subtitle = "Features with largest impact on risk score",
            x = NULL,
            y = "Coefficient Value"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "top")
      })
      
      # Survival curve visualization
      output$lasso_survival <- renderPlot({
        # Create reference curves for high and low risk groups based on training data
        median_score <- median(train_scores)
        train_high_risk <- clinical_matched$survival_time[train_scores > median_score]
        train_high_event <- clinical_matched$event[train_scores > median_score]
        train_low_risk <- clinical_matched$survival_time[train_scores <= median_score]
        train_low_event <- clinical_matched$event[train_scores <= median_score]
        
        high_surv <- survfit(Surv(train_high_risk, train_high_event) ~ 1)
        low_surv <- survfit(Surv(train_low_risk, train_low_event) ~ 1)
        
        # Compare curves
        plot(high_surv, col = "red", lwd = 2, 
             xlab = "Years", ylab = "Survival Probability", 
             main = "Kaplan-Meier Curves by Risk Group")
        lines(low_surv, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
        
        # Add patient's risk group indicator
        if (risk_group == "High") {
          abline(v = median(train_high_risk[train_high_event == 1]), lty = 2, col = "darkred")
          text(median(train_high_risk[train_high_event == 1]), 0.2, "Median Survival\n(High Risk)", col = "darkred")
        } else {
          abline(v = median(train_low_risk[train_low_event == 1], na.rm = TRUE), lty = 2, col = "darkblue")
          text(median(train_low_risk[train_low_event == 1], na.rm = TRUE), 0.2, "Median Survival\n(Low Risk)", col = "darkblue")
        }
        
        legend("topright", legend = c("High Risk", "Low Risk", "Patient Group"), 
               col = c("red", "blue", ifelse(risk_group == "High", "darkred", "darkblue")), 
               lty = c(1, 1, 2), lwd = c(2, 2, 1))
      })
      
      # Top genes output
      output$lasso_important_genes <- renderPrint({
        nonzero_coefs <- coef(lasso_mod)[, 1][coef(lasso_mod)[, 1] != 0]
        nonzero_coefs <- nonzero_coefs[names(nonzero_coefs) != "(Intercept)"]
        top_genes <- sort(abs(nonzero_coefs), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
        
        cat("Top 10 genes in LASSO Cox model (by coefficient magnitude):\n")
        for (i in 1:10) {
          if (i <= length(top_genes)) {
            gene <- names(top_genes)[i]
            coef_val <- nonzero_coefs[gene]
            direction <- ifelse(coef_val > 0, "increases", "decreases")
            cat(i, ". ", gene, " (", round(coef_val, 3), "): ", direction, " risk\n", sep = "")
          }
        }
      })
      
      # Clinical interpretation
      output$lasso_interpretation <- renderUI({
        # Determine risk level more precisely (low, medium, high)
        percentile <- score_quantile * 100
        risk_level <- case_when(
          percentile < 25 ~ "very low",
          percentile < 50 ~ "low",
          percentile < 75 ~ "moderate",
          percentile < 90 ~ "high",
          TRUE ~ "very high"
        )
        
        # Identify top contributing factors
        nonzero_coefs <- coef(lasso_mod)[, 1][coef(lasso_mod)[, 1] != 0]
        nonzero_coefs <- nonzero_coefs[names(nonzero_coefs) != "(Intercept)"]
        
        # For patient values, check which genes are contributing most to their score
        x_patient <- lasso_df[, names(nonzero_coefs), drop = FALSE]
        contributions <- as.numeric(x_patient) * nonzero_coefs
        top_contrib_idx <- order(abs(contributions), decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]
        top_contrib_genes <- names(nonzero_coefs)[top_contrib_idx]
        
        # Generate clinical interpretation
        HTML(paste0(
          "<p>This patient has a <strong>", risk_level, " risk profile</strong> (", round(percentile), "th percentile) based on the LASSO Cox model. ",
          "The risk score of ", round(lp, 2), " places them ",
          ifelse(lp > 0, "above", "below"), " the cohort average.</p>",
          
          "<p>Key factors contributing to this risk assessment include:</p>",
          "<ul>",
          "<li>Clinical factors: ", input$stage, " stage melanoma, age ", input$age, "</li>",
          "<li>Molecular signature: Notable expression of genes ", paste(top_contrib_genes, collapse = ", "), "</li>",
          "</ul>",
          
          "<p>Patients with similar molecular profiles in the TCGA cohort had ",
          ifelse(risk_group == "High", "shorter", "longer"), " than median survival times.</p>"
        ))
      })
    }
    
    # Model comparison - only run if both models are selected
    if (input$model_choice == "both") {
      # Combine results from both models for comparison
      output$comparison_summary <- renderPrint({
        cat("Risk Assessment Comparison:\n\n")
        cat("LASSO Cox Model:\n")
        cat("  Risk Score:", round(lp, 3), "\n")
        cat("  Risk Percentile:", round(score_quantile * 100), "%\n")
        cat("  Risk Classification:", risk_group, "\n\n")
        
        cat("Random Forest Model:\n")
        cat("  Predicted Survival:", round(pred_time, 2), "years\n")
        cat("  Risk Classification:", rf_risk_group, "\n\n")
        
        # Determine agreement between models
        models_agree <- (risk_group == rf_risk_group)
        
        cat("Model Agreement:", ifelse(models_agree, "Yes", "No"), "\n")
        cat("Overall Risk Assessment: ")
        
        if (models_agree) {
          cat(risk_group, "Risk\n")
        } else {
          # When models disagree, provide nuanced interpretation
          cat("Mixed - LASSO suggests", tolower(risk_group), "risk, while Random Forest suggests", 
              tolower(rf_risk_group), "risk\n")
        }
      })
      
      # Create comparison visualization
      output$comparison_plot <- renderPlot({
        # Normalize both scores to 0-1 scale for comparison
        # For LASSO, higher score = higher risk
        # For RF, lower predicted survival = higher risk
        
        # Get ranges from training data
        lasso_range <- range(train_scores)
        rf_range <- range(predict(rf_model, expr_survival))
        
        # Normalize scores (for LASSO, higher is higher risk; for RF, lower is higher risk)
        norm_lasso <- (lp - lasso_range[1]) / (lasso_range[2] - lasso_range[1])
        norm_rf <- 1 - ((pred_time - rf_range[1]) / (rf_range[2] - rf_range[1]))
        
        # Create data frame for plotting
        plot_data <- data.frame(
          Model = c("LASSO Cox", "Random Forest"),
          Risk = c(norm_lasso, norm_rf)
        )
        
        # Add reference data from training set
        set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
        sample_idx <- sample(nrow(expr_survival), min(100, nrow(expr_survival)))
        sample_lasso <- (train_scores[sample_idx] - lasso_range[1]) / (lasso_range[2] - lasso_range[1])
        sample_rf <- 1 - ((predict(rf_model, expr_survival[sample_idx,]) - rf_range[1]) / 
                         (rf_range[2] - rf_range[1]))
        
        ref_data <- data.frame(
          Model = rep(c("LASSO Cox", "Random Forest"), each = length(sample_idx)),
          Risk = c(sample_lasso, sample_rf),
          Type = "Reference"
        )
        
        plot_data$Type <- "Patient"
        combined_data <- rbind(plot_data, ref_data)
        
        # Create the comparison plot
        ggplot() +
          # Add density plot of reference data
          geom_density(data = ref_data, aes(x = Risk, fill = Model), alpha = 0.3) +
          # Add patient's scores as vertical lines
          geom_vline(data = plot_data, aes(xintercept = Risk, color = Model), 
                    linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
          # Add text labels for patient scores
          geom_text(data = plot_data, 
                   aes(x = Risk, y = 0.5 + as.numeric(Model=="Random Forest")*2, 
                       label = paste0(Model, ": ", round(Risk*100), "%"), color = Model),
                   hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
          # Styling
          scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
          scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
          xlim(c(0, 1.3)) +  # Extended to show labels
          labs(
            title = "Risk Score Comparison Between Models",
            subtitle = "Patient's risk scores (dashed lines) relative to training cohort (density curves)",
            x = "Normalized Risk Score (0 = Lowest Risk, 1 = Highest Risk)",
            y = "Density"
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(legend.position = "top")
      })
    }
  })

  observeEvent(session$clientData$url_search, {
    query <- parseQueryString(session$clientData$url_search)
    if (!is.null(query[["tab"]])) {
      updateTabItems(session, "tabs", query[["tab"]])
    }
  })
}
```
